payload.blocks: Only phase 4 and the plan's done; phases 1-4 are landed on main (7717d9a05) and nothing else waits.
payload.headline: Who runs the heads-rotate plan's full-suite gate on the host, since every sandbox here cannot?

parts.cause: npm test must take ~/.local/state/fgos/locks/full-suite.lock, which is read-only in every confined head and unit, the supervisor's included; the 7 cargo reds judge host process liveness, which a PID namespace hides. Same situation as q-vgwalbohwj, which you answered with a host run.

options.cost: One host run plus one lead pass.
options.does: On the host, run npm test and cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast on current main and drop both logs under plans/261122-2307-heads-rotate-on-their-own/reports/; the lead classifies reds against base 27fd8a9b0 and closes phase 4.
options.gain: Acceptance 6 proven for real; the 7 confinement reds get a verdict.
options.harm: About 15 minutes of host suite time.
options.label: Host run by the owner

options.does: Close phase 4 on the sandbox cargo run and the land-door tests, with npm test unrun and the 7 reds recorded as sandbox reds.
options.harm: A real red would go unowned; npm test never ran on the combined tree.
options.label: Accept the sandbox gate

parts.recommendation: Host run, as for q-vgwalbohwj: the sandbox cannot tell real reds from sandbox ones and could not run npm test at all.

scope.allows: One host full-suite run on current main and the lead classifying reds in the plan's integration report.
scope.forbids: Fixing any red outside this plan's footprint, or skipping checks with env switches.

parts.what: Acceptance 6 needs npm test and cargo test --workspace green on main at or after 7717d9a05. In the lead's and a unit's sandbox, cargo ran 563 passed, 7 failed (all in apps/fgos/src/wiring/doctor/confinement.rs, a module this plan does not touch); npm test did not start. Report: plans/261122-2307-heads-rotate-on-their-own/reports/lead-261123-0214-heads-rotate-wave-run.md.
